<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 0 0% 0%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 93%;
  --card: 0 0% 4%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 93%;
  --popover: 0 0% 4%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 93%;
  --muted: 0 0% 9%;
  --muted-foreground: 0 0% 63%;
  --accent: 0 0% 13%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 93%;
  --border: 0 0% 16%;
  --input: 0 0% 20%;
  --ring: 0 0% 93%;
  font-family: Geist, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background-color: #000000;
}
.login-background > div:first-child,
.login-content,
#footer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.login-background::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 56px 56px;
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 40%, #000000 30%, transparent 75%);
  mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 40%, #000000 30%, transparent 75%);
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 400px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid #262626;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02), 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px solid #262626;
  background: #0a0a0a;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: #262626 !important;
  color: #ededed;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #a1a1a1;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 40px;
  border: 1px solid #333333;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  color: #ededed;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: #ededed;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #525252;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: #ededed;
  border-color: #ededed;
  color: #0a0a0a;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #ededed;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  text-decoration-color: #525252;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #ededed;
  color: #0a0a0a;
  font-weight: 500;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: #cccccc;
}
#footer {
  color: #737373;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
